tips.text:
NOTES:
• Firstly, this is a work in progress. It will be updated as I play and refine the build.

• Second, I will not be copying builds. This will be my own "cooking" designed mainly for PVP, this is because high end PVP will require optimized builds much more then PVE content clearing. The best choice is to eventually have one for each.

• The best example of this will be skills, honestly over geared is over geared for both PVP and PVE. However, that advantage won't last forever.

• No I don't own every skin and pet in the game, nor do you. What you see is the worst case scenario not best case that no one has yet.

• Prioritize Space, Destiny, and Life when you can.

• Will add arcana later, but really that can be based on what your gear looks like.

• PVP SKILLS ARE [Under Construction - WIP] - (There are some TIPS in the description of the PvP skill page).

• Skill pages in general might need a bit a clarity work so [WIP] - Currently I couldn't decide if I wanted to use the priority tab for leveling prio or casting prio

• I am testing the builds extensively currently in the highest end parts of the game.

• I may consider getting dex on gear but realistically its kinda troll but ill mess with a private QL build to see if there are any setups to leverage DEX (which gives block).

• There is a build for every tier of the games content, all are complete except the end-game PvP / PvE W/Stat Prio Builds.

• Blue gear is interchangeable as long as the base gear score is somewhat is near the gear shown.

• At most stages if you need some extra GS for next content bracket without spending resources, check all the shops, daevanation max, and cheese with manastones.

• Same with faction gear its the base GS that matters not the name.

• Join my guild if you want HC/Semi-HC (Open Join) <DebaucheryTP> - (Yes its a Log Horizon "Debauchery Tea Party" Reference.

tips.title: PVE Templar Skills (Realistic)
tips.text:
• Hold left and right click for best macro damage or add [Vicious Strikes] at bottom if you are lazy, but you lose DPS.

• You can move the [Taunt] stigma + extra skills in its row around in the macro based on if it feels clunky or not. (Its personal preference).

• You can also use noble armor for more damage and the 1.5x [Insulting Roar] for holding agro. (Thats based on you group though, taunts is the "brain dead", "always works" angle).

• Include or remove Pummel if you are not having MP issues (AKA during leveling and early it can drain you).

• I personally don't remove it I swap specialty keystones based on content if I need more MP.

• Macro should be updated now.

Why i shouldn't go for resplended dragon? they are BiS.
Answer: right now every whale is trying to get their hands on those items, so what can we do to make a profit out of it? Sell every blue artisan orb that sells for more than 500k (or just gamba to sell the iem).
If you are going for the resplended dragon pieces you need to keep in mind that every piece you get needs the same (artisan) piece 2 more times in order to get an item with itemlevel higher than ludra.

Regarding items:
what works for me is the following:
you drop a golden chest piece. you check the endgame build, and you see that the piece you dropped has no good stats for you.
you then ask yourself, is this the last time that i am going to drop a chest of this rarity?
if for example you dropped a vakron chest piece, you are going to change it for Nuakum, so you just use that terrible chest, and hope for a better Nuakum drop down the line.
what you do on this scenario is getting it to +10 and use it till your next drop.

this build pulls huge dps, most of the time i am top dps in my team.

in the future i will add the pvp section.

generally this is going to be a f2p guide with items you can achieve in the first season (and before ludra raid).

Updates and FAQ:

Why i shouldn't go for resplended dragon? they are BiS.
Answer: right now every whale is trying to get their hands on those items, so what can we do to make a profit out of it? Sell every blue artisan orb that sells for more than 500k (or just gamba to sell the iem).
If you are going for the resplended dragon pieces you need to keep in mind that every piece you get needs the same (artisan) piece 2 more times in order to get an item with itemlevel higher than ludra.

Regarding items:
what works for me is the following:
you drop a golden chest piece. you check the endgame build, and you see that the piece you dropped has no good stats for you.
you then ask yourself, is this the last time that i am going to drop a chest of this rarity?
if for example you dropped a vakron chest piece, you are going to change it for Nuakum, so you just use that terrible chest, and hope for a better Nuakum drop down the line.
what you do on this scenario is getting it to +10 and use it till your next drop.
on the other hand, you check the endgame build and that vakron piece you dropped has 2 stats that are BiS. When this happens, you hit the jackpot, get it to +10 and keep it, you are gonna transfer it to your Nuakum later on and probably to your ludra/dragon chest. In my experience an item that has 2 or more stats that are BiS is very rare to get.

if the piece you dropped is a Nuakum, you are probably not gonna change it soon enough, so you can either choose to let it like this and hope for ludra drop, or you can use your golden books to refresh the stats. Generally speaking, i would refresh stats untill i get 1 BiS , then i would roll the rest with syncing, but be carefull with this, you generally want to first roll your rings/weapon/guard/neck/earrings then go for the ultra nieche stuff (other than some pieces that get double chance and damage speed).
the stats i've added to the items in the endgame build are the good stuff, the rest can be fillers as long as you get those.

REGARDING GENUS INSIGHT:
added genus insight board for the endgame build, this is generally what you should go for in your rolls.
As a reminder this is a build that is mostly dps, and less tanky, but generally speaking the way genus insight is right now a slot focuses either on tankiness or dps.
Also for the most efficient way to use your crystals is:
1. you farm pets untill you get the genus insight to level 8(other than special board that you have to get it by refreshing to lvl 10).
• you roll your genus from lvl 8 to lvl 10, ideally you want to get a heroic of 80%+ percent (from min to max), and ideally not getting more than 4 BiS stats that you lock while you are lvl 9 and rolling to lvl 10.(you are so lucky that you get unlucky).

• prioritize perfect chance and damage boost, they are the first priority and they can be rolled only on specific slots.(gives you more dps + a chance to double proc your punishment damage (300k dps per skill)).

• front crit is there because you will mostly be in front of the boss anyway and if you are not in front of it then probably your party isnt going to give you a thumbs up afterwards.

• Defence is generally prioritized than front/back defense or hp, since you get more effectiveness out defence and that 20 defense you get from back/front defense genus insight is not generally worth it ( why get 200 frontal defence and not 180 from all sources of damage?)

• if you are towards your perfect genus insight, you can just lock stats that are just good.As an example, you are not getting max att

tips.title: PvP Templar Skills (Realistic)
tips.text:
• Hold left and right click for best macro damage or add [Vicious Strikes] at bottom if you are lazy, but you lose DPS.

• The most important thing for damage is [Judgement] Resets

• The MOST IMPORTANT THING PERIOD IS [Debilitating Smash] - CAST IT AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE - 60% HEAL CUT + defense reduction IS REQUIRED FOR ALL PvP period.

• [Punishment] - I mostly tap it/cancel it for the buff then go back to my rotation.

• It generally feels bad to charge skills in PvP so if you want to drop it and just take the L on the executioner buff that's up to you.

• Stigma [Assault Fury] is optional swap it if you don't like it, I like the results but it feels like shit and is clunky.

• Secret Goat Passive is [Survival Willpower] - CC resist is amazing and only become more amazing the more apes trying to CC you at once.

• Your [CC BREAK] [Defiance] has amazing nodes INCLUDING a cheeky THIRD pull.
